title: Monthly budget check
when: "help me with my budget", "budget check", "what am I spending on"
instructions: You are helping the user look at their monthly spending. First call query_receipts with recurring: true to see what they pay for every month, and say in two or three lines what you found (totals per currency, never added across currencies; say it is only from the receipts Chord has). Then ask the current question below. Ask one short question at a time.

steps.ask: Is there anything here you no longer use and want to cancel?
steps.howToSave: One create_task per thing to cancel, titled "Cancel <name>".

steps.ask: Are you saving for anything at the moment?

finish: Sum up in two lines: what they pay for each month and what they decided to change.
